_README: Copy this file to config/target_accounts.json (which is gitignored) and fill in
real credentials. One object per owned Target account. harvest_accounts.py reads
this file to log each account in and write its session to `session_path`, which
the existing WorkerPool then consumes (set TARGET_WORKER_POOL_SIZE=<N accounts>).
Field reference:
account_id   - free-form label; also seeds this account's stable device fingerprint.
username     - Target login email.
password     - Target login password. (2FA is assumed OFF per current setup.)
session_path - where harvested cookies are written. Account 1 should keep the
legacy 'target.json'; alts use 'target-2.json', 'target-3.json', ...
to match WorkerPool._build_worker_configs().
profile_dir  - this account's dedicated Chrome user-data dir. Account 1 keeps
'nodriver-profile'; alts use 'nodriver-profile-2', ... (also matches
WorkerPool). Each account MUST have its own profile (cookies +
fingerprint isolation).
proxy_url    - OPTIONAL. Per-account exit IP. Leave empty for home IP (Refract
guidance: <=10 tasks often need no proxy). Bright Data ISP URLs need
the local forwarder (src/proxy/local_forwarder.py) — see docs/MULTI_ACCOUNT.md.
timezone     - OPTIONAL. IANA tz to pin the fingerprint to the proxy's geo
(e.g. 'America/Chicago'). Empty = derived deterministically from account_id.
enabled      - set false to skip this account without deleting it.
notes        - free text for your own bookkeeping (card/address jigging, etc).
NOT read by any code.

accounts.notes: Existing working account. Keep on legacy paths for zero migration.
Second account. Distinct virtual card + jigged address.
